A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the large fragment is placed in a C-terminal position in the native enzyme.

the small fragment of DNA polymerase has an amino-acid sequence of 20 residues, that it is placed in the extreme N-terminal region of the native enzyme, that it contains a single cysteine residue and a single histidine residue and that it contains no methionine residues.
DNA polymerase I is composed of a small fragment (mol.wt. 35,000) and a large fragment (mol.w.t. 100,000).
